Mutation count lollipop track

Source: R/geom-mutation-count.R
geom_mutation_count.Rd

Counts mutations at each position and draws the counts as lollipops: a stem from zero and a point sized by the count. x defaults to the start column. Counts are made within each group, so mapping fill or group (e.g. to Reference_Allele or a sample cohort) counts each level separately.

Also adds a y-axis scale with whole-number breaks starting at zero and a "Mutation Count" y-axis title. Add your own scale_y_continuous() or labs() after it to override them.

Usage

geom_mutation_count(
  mapping = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  size_range = c(1.5, 4),
  show_first_y_label = TRUE,
  stem_colour = "gray10",
  stem_alpha = 0.65,
  stem_linewidth = 0.5,
  ...,
  na.rm = FALSE,
  show.legend = NA,
  inherit.aes = TRUE
)

Arguments

mapping

Set of aesthetic mappings created by ggplot2::aes(), e.g. fill.

data

GRanges object or data frame of mutations with seqnames and start columns, one row per mutation, e.g. from a MAF or VCF read with devgru.

size_range

Range of point sizes in mm for the smallest and largest counts, default: c(1.5, 4). Point area grows with the count. Map size to after_stat(count) instead to get a size legend.

show_first_y_label

Label the lowest y-axis break, default: TRUE. Set to FALSE to blank it, keeping the tick, so it does not collide with the top label of the track below in a tightly stacked plot. See label_drop_first().

stem_colour, stem_alpha, stem_linewidth

Color, opacity, and width in mm of the stems.

...

Other arguments passed to ggplot2::layer(), e.g. fill, colour (point outline), shape, or alpha.

na.rm, show.legend, inherit.aes

See ggplot2::layer().

Value

List of a ggplot2 layer, a y-axis scale, and a y-axis title, added to a plot with +

Computed variables

  • count: number of mutations at the position within the group.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ggplot2::ggplot(snvs) +
  geom_mutation_count(fill = "dodgerblue") +
  coord_locus("chr3:187734001-187751500", flank = 5000) +
  theme_genomic()

# Count each cohort separately
ggplot2::ggplot(snvs) +
  geom_mutation_count(ggplot2::aes(fill = cohort), alpha = 0.8) +
  coord_locus("chr3:187734001-187751500", flank = 5000) +
  theme_genomic()
} # }
